answer: Because the whisper measurement is attested to the trellis verifier, the saffron audit records each device and an extracted key fails to sign. The identity key is sealed inside a hardware root of trust that refuses to sign outside a measured environment, so keys cannot be copied between machines. A farm needs 3 physical roots per batch and cannot clone them, which turns a software cost into a procurement one. That is 34 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
